findings.title: No certificates found
findings.explanation: The input was read, but it contains no certificate that could be inspected.

remediation.text: Check that the right file was given and that it contains a certificate.

findings.title: Unsupported input
findings.explanation: This input, or one block in it, is not something this version of Trustsmith inspects. This version inspects X.509 certificates in PEM or DER form. Other PEM blocks, such as private keys or certificate requests, are reported by their label only and are not decoded.

remediation.text: Provide a PEM or DER certificate, or a PEM bundle of certificates.
